They are very salty, which I should have expected because of the high level of electrolytes, but the flavors are great. The fruit punch and strawberry lemonade are probably my favorite. The one thing I will say is that in my opinion, your water needs to be ice cold or made in a cup with lots of ice. If they get warm they become much less pleasant lol.
